title: tab/devtools
description: Open Chromium's DevTools front end for a tab as a windowless tab of its own (CefBrowserHost::ShowDevTools with windowless rendering), bound to the page. Before answering, the engine sends tab/resized for the DevTools tab's first region; tab/frame and tab/state follow for it as for any tab, and input reaches it through tab/input. A second request for the same tab answers the open DevTools tab (with `inspectAt`, it also inspects that element). The DevTools tab closes with its page (tab/closed for both); tab/close on it closes DevTools only. It is not a page target: tab/cdp on it is refused (-32001).

tab.description: The tab's id, as tab/create answered it ("1", "2", ...; never reused in one engine process).

width.description: The DevTools view's width in CSS pixels.

inspectAt.description: Inspect the element at this point of the page (CSS pixels of the page's view): the context menu's Inspect.

tab.description: The tab's id, as tab/create answered it ("1", "2", ...; never reused in one engine process).

created.description: False when DevTools was open already.
